'''November 2000 Williston Park tournament (11 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Williston Park, NY on 11 November 2000. [[Brad Vogel]] won it. It is known from Chris Wodicka's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1459">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-14-williston-park-ny-11-11-00-im-koreand1459/ williston-park-ny-11-11-00-im-korean], DeckTech (Chris "Wedge231" Wodicka, 14 November 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-11-14-williston-park-ny-11-11-00-im-koreand1459/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 11 November 2000
* '''Site:''' Williston Park, NY
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Jabba's Palace Sealed Deck]]
* '''Players:''' 10
* '''Winner:''' [[Brad Vogel]]
